statement: Ordinary local quadratic and quaternion-subform decisions plus global quadratic isometry isotropy square and norm decisions over all explicit odd global function fields
depends_on: C:global-function-field-arithmetic; local residue forms; LUVG quadratic Hasse and local quaternion classification
notes: Finite-digit splitting certificates and all-place dovetailing have proved termination. No finite bad-place bound or arbitrary-stream equality oracle is used.

statement: Actual isometry of all quaternion skew-hermitian forms over explicit odd global function fields is decidable with positive isometries constructed
depends_on: C:global-function-local-form-algorithms; LUVGTheorem2.7(ii); explicit rank-one conjugator and norm criterion
notes: Rank at least2 uses the strong representation theorem; the final rank-one two-sign norm test retains the genuine failure of local-global isometry.

statement: Every sign over every finite division algebra with linear involution over explicit odd global function fields has decidable actual isometry and literal canonical finite Gram and virtual-pair coordinates
notes: First kind reduces to degree1or2; all unitary degrees use rank and computed reduced norm modulo a decidable quadratic norm group. Canonical coordinates have a terminating equality test.
